content.short: DefiLlama is a DeFi analytics dashboard for TVL, stablecoins, DEX volume, fees, revenue, yields, and protocol rankings.
content.description: DefiLlama is a crypto analytics platform focused on transparent DeFi data. It tracks total value locked, protocol rankings, chain metrics, stablecoin supply, DEX and perpetual volume, fees, revenue, unlocks, yields, and other market data from across the on-chain ecosystem. The site also links to products such as LlamaSwap, LlamaSearch, APIs, and research resources. For Mantle users, DefiLlama is useful for comparing ecosystem protocols, monitoring liquidity and activity, and understanding how Mantle-based DeFi apps perform against other chains and categories.
content.meta: DefiLlama tracks TVL, volume, fees, revenue, yields, and protocol rankings across DeFi. Discover DefiLlama on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
